repositories.name: infrabot-hardware
repositories.en: H7C arm mechanical CAD: assembly STEP with the joint motors, STEP files for the 43 machined parts, and a BOM with part previews.
repositories.zh: H7C 机械臂的机械图纸：含关节电机的整机 STEP、43 种机加工零件的 STEP，以及带零件预览的物料清单。

repositories.name: infrabot-description
repositories.en: H7C URDF, meshes and identified inertia and friction. ROS 2 Jazzy package.
repositories.zh: H7C 的 URDF、网格和辨识得到的惯量与摩擦参数，ROS 2 Jazzy 功能包。

repositories.name: infrabot-pcb-4p3-enclosure
repositories.en: 3D-printable enclosures for the 4.3-inch controller: Simple S8 with two shells and Deluxe C3 with keycaps and light pipes. STL and STEP.
repositories.zh: 4.3 寸控制器的 3D 打印外壳：简单版 S8 为上下壳两件，精装版 C3 带键帽和导光柱。提供 STL 和 STEP。

repositories.name: infrabot-pcb-4p3
repositories.en: Four-layer carrier board for the STM32H743 core module and 4.3-inch panel: EasyEDA project, schematics, Gerbers, BOM and CPL.
repositories.zh: STM32H743 核心板和 4.3 寸屏的四层底板：嘉立创 EDA 工程、原理图、Gerber、BOM 和坐标文件。

repositories.name: infrabot-firmware
repositories.en: STM32H743 firmware: 1 kHz joint control, gravity compensation, impedance and admittance, touchscreen UI, signed A/B updates.
repositories.zh: STM32H743 固件：1 kHz 关节控制、重力补偿、阻抗与导纳、触摸屏界面、签名 A/B 升级。

repositories.name: infrabot-sdk
repositories.en: Linux C++17 and Python SDK over Ethernet, Qt control GUI and firmware update tools.
repositories.zh: 基于以太网的 Linux C++17 / Python SDK、Qt 控制界面和固件升级工具。

repositories.name: infrabot-ros2
repositories.en: ROS 2 Jazzy ros2_control driver for J1–J7 with a 1 kHz controller manager, joint trajectory controller and mock hardware.
repositories.zh: ROS 2 Jazzy 的 ros2_control 驱动，控制 J1–J7：1 kHz 控制循环、关节轨迹控制器和 mock 硬件。

repositories.name: lerobot-robot-infrabot
repositories.en: LeRobot robot plugin for teleoperation, recording and policy deployment.
repositories.zh: LeRobot 机器人插件，用于遥操作、数据采集和策略部署。
